triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: Same defect as ch25: the section 122 surcharge was zeroed on China-301 list-1 and section-232-aluminum membership rather than on the source's exclusion-list and section-232-covered-metal exemptions, suppressing the surcharge on 301-listed lines of every origin.

triage.verifier_justification: The pre-fix `section_122_component_rate` version-2 formula zeroed the 10 percent surcharge on the union of two witness exemplar flags, and the same module simultaneously uses `entry_is_line_a` as the China-301 list-1 gate (`if entry_is_line_a and origin_is_china: list_1_additional_ad_valorem_rate`) and `entry_is_line_b` as the section-232-aluminum / China-301 2024-action gate, so no caller assignment can make both rules match the source — the §122 exemption necessarily captured the wrong population of entries. Read through the pinned release, the cited source (Proclamation 11012, FR 2026-03824) exempts only "articles listed in paragraph 2 of Annex I ... and as enumerated in Annex II" and "all articles and parts of articles currently or that later become subject to additional import restrictions imposed pursuant to section 232", and expressly says the surcharge "is in addition to any other duties" — there is no §301-membership exemption, and the §232 carve-out covers steel and copper, not aluminum alone. The fix repoints the gate to `entry_is_section_122_exempt or entry_is_section_232_covered` while leaving the rule's proof atoms, versions, dates and stack position identical, which is a pure change of the exempted population rather than a provenance or serialization edit, so it is fidelity and not mechanical. I considered reclassifying to untraceable_branch (the §301-keyed condition has no basis in the §122 proclamation) but the branch itself is source-grounded — the exemption exists and the atoms already cited it — and what changed is which articles it captures, which is squarely wrong_entity_or_scope.

triage.verifier_notes: inferred from verified sibling module index 24 (same kind and rule path in this chunk). Refutation attempts and what survived. (1) "Mechanical rename": refuted — one old flag maps to several distinct new flags (`entry_is_line_b` becomes `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` in the aluminum component but `entry_is_china_301_2024_action` in the 301 component), and the §122 gate moves to a different population entirely; the summary's boilerplate "changes no formula tokens ... or runtime values" is contradicted by the diff itself. (2) "Enhancement / new scope the module never claimed": refuted — the generated ch25 composition already claims chapter-wide scope (it stacks components over `chNN_general_rate[hts_line]` for any chapter-25 line), and the PR's own gate evidence enumerates "18 explained" witness-slice cells "where the witness's own coupling was the unlawful part", i.e. wrong outputs, not absent coverage. (3) "Pre-fix was correct": on the witness's five exemplar lines it was — `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded: entry_is_line_a` is atom-cited to 7202.11.10 (a §122-exempt line) and `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded: entry_is_line_b` to 9903.01.33 aluminum scope — but that correctness cannot survive chapter-scale reuse of the same flags as 301-list gates. Residual uncertainty a reviewer should weigh: the module text alone is ambiguous about which direction entry preparation populated `entry_is_line_a` (annex-exclusion membership vs. 301 list-1 membership); the PR body settles it ("unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins"), so my confidence rests partly on the PR message rather than on the diff alone. Two further observations: the pre-fix gate also under-exempted, since `entry_is_line_b` covered aluminum only while the source exempts §232-covered steel and copper too; and the fix is partial — `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded` and `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still ride on `entry_is_line_a`/`entry_is_line_b` in the post file (post lines 1907, 1924). This is a `module.kind: composition` file produced by generator b1.6 rather than encoder output; it is still a RuleSpec v1 rule module with formulas and versions, so not_a_rule_module does not apply, but the upstream defect lives in the hand-built witness the generator copied. Source pages cited by the atoms (us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-221/226/230) do not resolve to the surcharge text in the pinned corpus release (rev 3, us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap) — the exemption text was verified instead through us/rulemaking/federal-register/2026-02-25/2026-03824, which the rule also cites. Other components in the same commit carry different kinds (Brazil/forced-labor 301 gain a missing listed-membership condition; the added `section_232_steel_component_rate` is new coverage) and should be judged separately.
